translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Got ami Sinik Abem dabadála madák tasa ami sung uta ko.
Kale God Kámin ban bomin am dánane Yesus aket kudawsiw kinim iyo am mak kal dutam dá bom keim áliwo,
abid tikin kaw tam kalo bid weng dukum uyo gedul dukum taw dew madák am kaw tam uyo gedul bideng ki weinane,
ika kalomo, ukal yaknámin mak as daung dukum taw madák tadu ka. Kal bom keimiwe, as daung uyo taktak yak wanang so kinim so adikum kaw tam teinbiw imi al abune,
kabadákal Sinik Abem ayo tad im aket tem weinane, ika mit kei weng kukum kukum bakamsiw. Kale be Sinik Abem ata kanoyam kitid dauyamano kanodin weng weng be bakansiw ko.
Kale kanabiw bewák Yu kayak Got kalfalin wanang kinim seng ika anang bakan adikum kuw tabodu kal tada tada bom láw Yedusalem abiw kal teinbidiw.

Kale ika bideng kanodu bo kidi nadiwe aluk tad gei dau kidi nadiwe kol beso kuwo kalsiw. Be watawo kaleyo bá, Got afan kalin makuw makuw imi weng uyo ita baka bada baka bada kei bidiw kidi nadiwo kayo ko.
Kale ika aket diking dakung bom nadiwade bako, “kuin, kinim bidi Galili kayak!
Kata yakno yakno ika makuw makuw num weng uyo baka bidiw nuka kidibuwe?
Nuka Badtiniyan kayak, Mites kayak, Elam kayak, Mesabotemiya kayak, Yuddia kayak, Kabaddosiya kayak, Bantas kayak, ade Eisa kayak,
Fadisia kayak, Bamfiliya kayak, Isiw kayak, ade Libiya bakan Saidin abiw mewso so biyámin kinim ade madik nuka Udom kayak,

kata madik nuka Yu kayak ade madik nuka Mifiwo maek Yu kayak wol fewa atin Yu kayak keisuduw ade madik nuka Kadít kayak ade Edaw kayak nuka tada tada ausaduw, kata nuka kinim bidi nulum weng baka bom nadiwe Got ami kukuw dukum kanaba sung uyo adikum bakayabiw.” Kalsiw.
Ika aket diking dakung bom nadiwe amon bom weng dákadálawa dákadálawa bom, “utakun mit utane utane?” Kalbidiwe,
kinim madik itane tudom diyam bom nadiwe bakodiw, “Yesus afan kalin ika wok mafak seng kuw wan bi bom aket wakwayabano.” Yaksiw.
Kale Bita aka kinim kum kal so tod be. Kale aka kinim wanang seng seng iyo weng dukum kuw bakoyam, “adikum Yu kayak tad Yedusalem tasidiw kiba, nam weng be kidela kidinamiwo mit dákafiyamon kala.
Kale kim aket bako kinim bidi wok mafak seng wane aket dakwayabano kalbiw, kata atan sinik bo kama matam bati dim aba kayo be wok mafak wane aket dakwayamin umi atan bá.
Kale mew imi kanabiw sung be lum senin kinim Yoel, aka bakosa kale.
Got ayo bakoyam,

content.text: ‘am adik adik dánokaba kal nam Sinik Abem ayo dabadáli dák nadano adikum kinim so wanang so imi dim abokaba. Kale kim muduw iyo lum weng bakanokabiw. Ade kimi kinim kasá kasá ika Got wisin bo utamanokabiw ade kimi kinim fasel ika lum seng bomokabiw.
Ade am adik adik dána tadu naka nam Sinik Abem dabadáli dák nam wok fakudin wanang so nam wok fakudin kinim so im dim aba, ika lum weng bakanokabiw ko.
Kale naka abid tikin katam uyo mudi mudín kukuw kukuyamokabi ade bakan kadák akal dubat dubatin kukuw kukuyamokabi, be kaim so as kainin so as lek bakiyámin so uta kukuyamokabi.
Ade atan ayo midilokaba, alo kayow akal isak bino kaim alataw keidokaba. Kale be kana bi tade unuyo Kamok am, am dukum so lamlam so dánámin uyo tadokabu.
Kale kan kinim wanang ita Kamok dakonamako, kale win gán dádawokabiw, Kamok akal kail bá takeikuyamokabano.’

content: Got Yoel dim bako kalesa.

Kale Isadael kinim kiba, weng bela kidilino, Got ayo Yesus Nasadet kayak alam dim kal dubat dubatin kukuw so aket diking dakung bom amonin kukuw so mudi mudín kukuw so uyo kilim iwyak tem kal kidelsa. Kale be kana badano kibi kiliwta utam kal keidomo aka atin Got alata dabadála tasa ka. Akeisidiw.

Kale Got aka suwayo kal alam kal ade alata bo kanodokabuno kalesa. Kayo Bailet Yesus ayo dabadáyama yak kilim teng dim aba, ban keimin kinim ita dakoyamiw as dawing dákamin dim dawti sil biki anbisidiw.

Kata Got aka dabadála fomongin banim tá dafo nadane atin Got dabadála dák kuin bid unemin umi kitid uyo kail bá takeikudaw min talá dause. Be watawo kaleyo bá, kuin bid uka ken kitid sono masi Yesus dew fakudomu banim.
Nulum awadik Dewit Yesus sung bakoyamsa uyo bako,

content.text: ‘naka sun kuw Kamok ayo nalam kin gubuyo kal atamábi, watawo kaleyo bá, aka nalam teng miskuno kal be, kayo naka fingánomi banim.
Beta kaleyo nam aket kidelnamábu ade nam weng bo kalfalin weng ki weinsu ade nam dam bo kikiláw, kata naka mimin dok di bom bo kanodokabu kalbi kayo nam aket bo dakbunamábu.
Watawo kaleyo bá, Natim Got kaba, namadálaw kano kuin bid bomi banim ade kaba kalam Kinim Abem ayo dabadálaw, ami dam uyo fomomu banim.
Kaba biyámin leiw kidel uyo kukunamsaw ade kalam kin gubuyo kal idak teinámin uyo weina namudokabaw.’

content: Awadik Dewit weng kalesa.
Nalam nikil fikal kiba, naka kidela bakoyamon, atin afan num awadik Dewit aka fikala dausiw ade ami fom lung be kamane nuluso be.
Kata aka Got lum senin kinim ade aka Got weng takadálawsa bo alam kal. Kale aka weng abem bakodaw, ‘naka kam low mak walulino matam kalam Kamok keibadaw taw keidokaba.’ Akeisa.

Kale Dewit aka Got ami kanamokaba uyo utam nadano kayo aka Kadais ami talá tabamin sung bakansa uyo bako, ‘Natim Got kaba, dabadálaw kano kuin bid boma banim ade kaba kalam Kinim Abem ayo dabadálaw, ami dam uyo fomomu banim.’ Kalesa.
Kayo Got aka Yesus be tá dafoda ami dam uyo kudála fomongin banim keidune, adikum nuka mew kanabu bo kin walabuw.
Kale Got aka Yesus ayo alam teng miskuno kal dawti nadane win dukum kudaw nadane Sinik Abem weng takadálawsa uyo kudawane alo Yesus ayo Sinik Abem be min dabadála madák numal tad atamanbiw ka.
Dewit ayo dew tam abid tikin unongin banim, kata aka bakosa,

content.text: ‘Kamokim Got ayo nam Kamok bakodaw nadale tad nalam teng miskuno kal kano tein badawo
si kalam wasi iyo tudo imadew tad kalam akfak tem imtikamon kala.’

content: Kalesa.
Kaleyo adikum Isadael kayak kiba, nam weng dam bela kidela kidilino, Yesus kiliwta anak as dim dásidiw ayo Got bako nadane, ‘be kinim nam Walusi Kinim ade Kamok keidawsi.’ Kalesano,” Bita yakane,
wanang kinim iyo kidi nadiwe aket luklakyamane, ika Bita so weng dew kámin kinim madik so bakoyam, “duwal kiba, nuka yakodokabuwe?” Kaliwe,
Bita ayo bakoyam, “kiba ban keimin uyo ibik dumam nadiwe Yesus Kadais ami win tudow dim wok ban bodiwo, Got ayo kim ban keimin uyo lukuwá kudáyamane, kiba Got Sinik Abem min kudamin uyo kudulino.
Kale Got Sinik Abem weng takadáyamsa bela adikum kilimi ade kilim muduw adikum imi ade kinim wanang adikum teiniw mániw imi ade yak wanang kinim kan ata nulum Kamok Got alata gán dáyamokaba imi ko.
Kale Bita ayo weng kitid seng seng kuw bakoyam, “kiba, mew wanang kinim teiniw imi kukuw uyo takas kudá maek kaek abe kilim kál bábu takakudin kala.”
Kale wanang kinim madik seng seng (3000) ita Bita ami weng uyo atin afano kaliwe, wok ban boyamiw yak wanang kinim kanabiw imi wol bakesiw ko.
Afan kalin kinim tada tadasiw umi sung uta ko.
Kale Yesus afan kalin kinim ika tada tada bom weng dew kámin kinim im sawa kidi bom, imin fakel fakel wan bom nadiwe Got so weng bakan bom ilim ufek ufek uyo kudawa kudawasiw ko.
Kale weng dew kámin kinim ika mudi mudín kukuw so aket diking dakungin bom amonin kukuw so uyo seng kuw kana bidiwo wanang kinim seng seng iyo Got win dafádawsiw.
Kale Yesus afan kalin kinim iyo ulum kano dek amki tada tada bom nadiwe ufek ufek adikum uyo akanum kudawa kudawa bom nadiwe
ilim ufek ufek uyo wansiki dusiki bom nadiwo ta bom wanang kinim ufek ufek iwa bidiw iyo min moni kukayamsiw.
Kale Yesus afan kalin kinim iyo sun kuw tad Yol am kasadam tem tademámsiw. Kata ilim am am uyo aket dakbu idak tein bom nikil tada tada bom budet fakel fakel wan bom nadiwe
Got win kufádaw bom idak tein bidiwo, Yedusalem kayak iyo imi win kufáya bidiwe Got ayo wanang kinim makso makso ban keimin kail bá takeikuyamsa ko.
